latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release providing robust tools for clinical trial data cleaning and standardization:

- Cleans, validates, and standardizes clinical trial data to meet CDISC SDTM standards.
- Handles missing values, detects outliers, standardizes dates, and supports conversion of raw CRF data to CDISC format.
- Generates audit trails for regulatory compliance (FDA/EMA submissions).
- Includes command-line and Python API usage examples.
- Provides documentation and reference materials for regulatory and troubleshooting support.
